title: Professor Morgan

[[Image:ProfessorMorgan.png|thumb]]
'''Professor Morgan''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[7th House on the Left]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Speed]]
*+1 [[Fight]]

Increase your [[Combat check]] bonuses from [[Weapon]]s by +1.

==Mythos Source==
Francis Morgan is a Professor of Medicine and Comparative Anatomy at [[Miskatonic University]], appearing in ''The Dunwich Horror'' (1928), written by H.P. Lovecraft.
